description: Reviewed CI ratchet deltas for intentional functionality added before the architecture snapshots were refreshed. Every allowance is exact so unrelated growth or routes still fail. The route-manifest additions were folded into config/route-manifest.json on 2026-09-11, together with the three compact Sales Report routes added by #1379 and the Phase 4 proforma-capacity read added by #1382, so routeManifestAdditions is empty and any new route now fails until it is reviewed and folded the same way. config/source-text-assertion-baseline.json was regenerated once audit-source-text-assertions learned to see relative-URL source reads, so every test previously carried here as a reviewed delta now lives in that baseline, which is the canonical list. The source-text allowance covers assertions that landed on main after that baseline was taken, each on a test the baseline already records, led by the #1193 entry in server/routes/sp/spGoldenCoastPhase11MonthlyCloseRoutes.test.ts pinning the shared-charge Decimal expression. The three #1196 assertions in tests/supplier-partner-net-position-inclusion.test.ts that this file used to carry were removed by #1200, so the ceiling drops with them. godFileLineCaps is empty: every reviewed oversized file was split to or below the 900-line repository limit, so no line-cap allowances remain.

sourceTextAssertionDelta.rationale: Each entry asserts a contract that has no behavioural surface. The mobile-responsive files (phase1-critical-flows, wave2-factory-floor, wave3-erp-operations) assert on Tailwind breakpoint classes and data-testid template literals: jsdom applies no CSS, so which of the mobile and desktop views is visible at a breakpoint is only expressible as source text. realtime-wave2-live-page-policy asserts the ABSENCE of polling and of a second WebSocket in live pages — an absence no request can demonstrate. proforma-capacity-concurrency-wiring asserts that every proforma-linked creation path takes the capacity lock before it writes, and that the lock is taken first; ordering inside a transaction is not observable from outside it. company-deletion-contract asserts that storage.ts composes the dependency-aware deletion service rather than a second implementation, which is a wiring fact, not a result. factory-loading-soft-delete-overload-regression asserts that soft-deleted proformas and orders are excluded from the shared capacity snapshot and that both scan and bulk-import source their counts from it; the exclusion is a SQL predicate, so there is no request that can distinguish it from a count that happens to be equal. sales-report-compact-routes verifies that every sales-report URL the build-time Vite transform emits is registered by the mounted stats registry, and that the compact routes mount before the legacy raw route; the fetched URLs only exist after the transform runs, so no dev-mode request can demonstrate the wiring. tracking-continuous-list-cleanup asserts the ABSENCE of legacy pagination controls and page state after the continuous-list migration, keeps cursor-invariant failures as internal technical identifiers, and pins the quality-doc/type-escape-ceiling synchronisation; absences and cross-file sync have no request-observable surface. maxAdditionalTextAssertions is measured exactly at 171 over the reviewed baseline of 2061, so any further growth still fails.
